title: Runner protocol v1 request envelope
$comment: HARNESS.md 7.1-7.3. Runner JSON rejects unknown members, duplicate member names, and every bare JSON number; those lexical rules are enforced by the strict codec, this schema covers structure. Milestone 0 admits only the hello operation; later milestones extend the operation enum and per-operation input schemas without changing the envelope.

input.$comment: hello takes an empty input object.
